title: Tray of small gray angular particles
visual_facts: A shallow round clear glass dish is filled with many small angular gray particles.
A second similar dish is partly visible at the left edge.
The dishes rest on a white cloth or paper-covered work surface.
A translucent plastic bag and a white rectangular container are partly visible behind the dishes.
spatial_relations: The filled dish is in the foreground and center.
A second dish sits behind and to the left of the filled dish.
uncertainties: The material composition and purpose of the gray particles cannot be determined visually.
